statBlock.name: Fire Snake
statBlock.description: A salamander hatches as a fire snake after melting through the shell of its obsidian egg. It reaches adulthood within a year.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Heated Body. A creature that touches the snake, or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it, takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 265. The resistance uses the wording from the official errata.

statBlock.name: Mud Mephit
statBlock.description: A creature of earth and water that lodges complaints with anyone willing to stop and listen.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, sticky mud leaves the creature Restrained until the end of its next turn.
False Appearance. While motionless, the mephit looks like an ordinary mound of mud.
sections.Actions:
Fists. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Mud Breath (Recharge 6). Choose one creature within 5 ft. A Medium or smaller target must make a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

statBlock.name: Mud Mephit (Summoner Variant)
statBlock.description: A creature of earth and water that lodges complaints with anyone willing to stop and listen.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, sticky mud leaves the creature Restrained until the end of its next turn.
False Appearance. While motionless, the mephit looks like an ordinary mound of mud.
sections.Actions:
Fists. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Mud Breath (Recharge 6). Choose one creature within 5 ft. A Medium or smaller target must make a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Summon Mephits (1/day). The mud mephit has a 25 percent chance to summon 1d4 mud mephits. Each appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner and acts as its ally. The summoned mephits cannot summon other mephits. Each vanishes after 1 minute, when it or its summoner dies, or when the summoner spends an action to dismiss it.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 216. Mephit Summoning variant, p. 217.

statBlock.name: Smoke Mephit
statBlock.description: Smoke pours from this creature of air and fire. It likes to mock travelers and send them the wrong way.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, a sphere of smoke with a 5-ft. radius forms around the center of its space. The area is heavily obscured. Wind disperses the smoke, which lasts 1 minute without wind.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma. Once per day, the mephit casts Dancing Lights without material components.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Cinder Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must make a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.
